Dave Matthews Band
October 8, 2021
Fiddler's Green Amphitheatre - Greenwood Village, CO

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > Zoom F6 (32 Bit Float)
Location: Sec 101, Row LL, Seat 114, right of FOH, DFC, Mics DIN @ 9'.
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.36 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.0.5 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals

& Bourbons & Lacs and American Baby Intro interpolations

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting me set up at FOH.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers before me who continue to preserve live music.
